dossiers.missing_binding: A fixed independent written or otherwise owned relation must identify the referred-to material and its source role, separately from the assumed becomes/material nouns. The current unknown spans permit compatibility but cannot discriminate source from competing relational accounts. For a compound claim, source-boundary compatibility and actual semantic composition are separate requirements.

reopening.criteria_origin: Prospective review synthesis below, distinct from original preregistered fixed-sense constraints quoted above. Not experimental authorization.
all_of: Specify whether testing whole qol source reference, whole qolchedy composition, or an independent relation packet; do not share success/failure across those units.

For a meaning comparison, obtain independently constrained material/reference or argument binding, then freeze the unchanged source sense and rival predictions against that relation while preserving unknown words and repeats.

For scored relation evidence, use legitimately newly eligible source selection/provenance and pass every existing executable GDT388 gate; previously accessed data cannot be made unexposed by new labels.
not_sufficient: More rows from the same conditional cache or alternate readers counted as independent witnesses.
An all39 census by itself without a new discriminating ownership/reference constraint.
Smoother source-becomes-water German, known joined/split agreement, or same-author mutation PASS.
Formatting repair of invalid edge IDs without changed prior-access eligibility.
Silently changing source into causal/temporal reference or becomes into heats/contains.

dossiers.more_pages_vs_other_binding: More admitted pages could expose a concrete constraining relation or a real fixed-sense contradiction. Merely increasing occurrence counts leaves missing reference/meaning binding unchanged. The full all39 inventory was not done in823/824; its absence is a scope boundary, not missing data and not automatic justification for another census.
